text: you can validate it with the system already. no python. just use zig or ts and invoke all the same like how we use the v8 for our cli fn
resolution: Implemented the validator without Python: tools/validate-hmsc-workspace-layout bundles cart/hmsc-workspace-mock/layoutValidateCli.ts with tools/esbuild and invokes it through tools/v8cli, using the same host-style filesystem/stdout/exit bridge expected by the project CLI path.
